Stage In progress + This month + Incoming → parent unchanged (7 rows, count hidden, summary default) — staging real. Escape → sheet truly hidden, focus back on trigger, scroll unlocked, applied state intact. Reopen → staged = last applied (R-29 verified twice: default after cancel; "Received" after apply). Apply → count badge 3, summary "in-progress · this month · incoming", rows filtered, aria-expanded=false, focus restored. Filter-to-empty → no-results shown + list hidden; Clear → 7 rows restored. Sort "Largest amount" reorders live list (2150,1840,1200,800,450,300,90) with trigger value + aria-expanded reset + focus return. Sheet scrolls at 320 and 200% (header controls scroll internally). gaps: BLOCKING: component-gallery.js:408 — the [data-filter-clear] handler calls fireSnackbar(btn.closest(".screen"), "Filters cleared"), passing the family .screen element as the snackbar element. Consequences (both reproduced twice, cleanly): (1) the "Filters cleared" confirmation snackbar never renders; (2) 5 seconds later hideSnack() sets screen.hidden=true on the entire family container — the whole Filtering screen (or the #empty screen via its sibling clear button) vanishes from the gallery (computed display:none, offsetParent null). The restore itself works, so the coverage-matrix claim "Clear filters restores (verified)" passes an immediate assertion and then the demo is destroyed outside the verification window — exactly the attribute-vs-truth failure mode self-critique.md warns about. Fix is one line: fireSnackbar(mainSnack, "Filters cleared", null, null, btn.closest(".screen")). Re-verify with an assertion taken ≥6s after Clear.
Minor: filter trigger aria-expanded stays "true" after Cancel/Escape/scrim/drag close (only applyFilters() resets it, js:348/390) — stale ARIA state on all discard paths.

Clicking any 'Clear filters' button (data-filter-clear in #filtering's no-results state or #empty's no-results demo) (a) never shows the 'Filters cleared' snackbar and (b) 5000ms later hides the entire family screen (hidden=true → display:none) — the Filtering (or Empty) family vanishes from the gallery. Reproduced twice with clean reloads; final eval evidence: {filteringScreenHidden: true, screenDisplay: 'none', frameStillVisible: false} and {emptyScreenHidden5sLater: true}. This breaks the README-advertised try-it flow and the coverage-matrix 'Clear filters restores (verified)' claim beyond the assertion window. Fix: fireSnackbar(mainSnack, "Filters cleared", null, null, btn.closest(".screen")); re-verify with an assertion taken ≥6 seconds after Clear.

summary: The repaired 29-file package is substantially what it claims: every repair A–I is contract-documented, token-backed, rendered, and live-exercisable, and the previously-fatal honesty failures of the original run (documented-but-absent motion, attribute-level verification, coverage over-claims) are genuinely closed — I reproduced the token parity, the 39 coverage anchors, the mandated timing system, the six-state button, the staged filter sheet, real undo, the metric sum relationship, drag-to-dismiss, dual-ring focus, RTL/320/200% behavior, and source-pack integrity. One adversarial finding blocks publish: the Clear-filters handler passes the family screen into fireSnackbar(), so the advertised no-results→Clear flow silently destroys the Filtering (or Empty) family screen five seconds after use and never shows its confirmation snackbar — a defect that survived both the 67-check deterministic gate and the browser verification because both sampled before the 5s timer fired. Secondary findings: stale aria-expanded on filter cancel, the live completion window rendering disabled-grey instead of the documented positive tint (CSS specificity), a broken motion-token evidence capture, three byte-identical 'behavior' screenshots, and small doc nits. All are non-blocking. After BLK-01's one-line fix and a delayed-assertion re-verification, the package is handoff-ready.
